method: Residual recurrent actor and critic trained on actual four-second discounted returns and world-assisted one-step values. Use a matched instantaneous model and a frozen-embedding recurrent model as controls. Hidden state resets at trio entry, observation gaps and 3.2 game seconds. Identical base opening.
selection: Deploy only the fixed raw-state recurrent variant if both teacher-free mean future-mask and safe-output Brier losses improve relative to its instantaneous control; between 0.1% and 25% of valid held inputs may change; issued-teacher horizontal accuracy must remain within three percentage points. Frozen real fights then determine both targets.
